title: cytisus supinus var. stefanoffii
intro: Cytisus supinus var. stefanoffii, commonly known as Stefano's broom or a variety of the Broom of Spain, is a flowering plant species within the genus Cytisus. This plant is valued for its traditional use in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and gastrointestinal disorders. The health benefits of Cytisus supinus var. stefanoffii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
